listing.name: ksa-macos-molten-patcher
listing.abstract: Kitten Space Agency mod that makes the Windows game run on macOS in a Sikarugir (Wine) wrapper
listing.description:
## ⚠️ Warning

- Only for macOS users running KSA inside a **Sikarugir** wrapper, using the `WS12WineSikarugir10.0_6` engine.
- This is a highly experimental project. Proceed with caution.
- macOS is still not officially supported. Leave the devs alone.

---

A Kitten Space Agency mod that lets the Windows version of the game run on macOS in a Sikarugir (Wine) wrapper. A StarMap hook runs it before the game starts. It applies the patches in its `patches/` folder to the wrapper and the game files.

Each patch is a plain text file that says what it changes and why:
[ksa-macos-molten-patcher/patches](https://github.com/renancamm/ksa-macos-molten-patcher/tree/main/patches)

> 💬 *Have you figured out a new way to improve the macOS experience in KSA? Propose a new patch!*

---

## How to revert changes

The patches edit files in your wrapper and game folder. **Removing the mod does not undo them.**

Before changing a file, the mod saves the original next to it as `<file>.orig`, so every changed file has one. To revert:

1. Remove the mod.
2. Copy each `.orig` file back over its original.

---
